build_game_master: build a psychology experiment Game Master entity from a prefab with a language model and memory bank
create_game_master_prefab: create a GameMaster prefab with custom experiment component class, player entities, and scene specs
configure_experiment_component: configure the GameMaster prefab params with an experiment component class and its init kwargs
review_game_master_build: review the GameMaster build method to understand how components are assembled for the experiment
refactor_game_master_components: refactor the GameMaster prefab to add or swap context components like scene tracker or event resolution
